title: Yoisaki Kanade — Mouthpiece Challenge!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... Quite a lot happened today.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
I didn't mean to cause you two so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But I'm always having trouble, and making weird sounds. Because of that, I end up getting left out of performances...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I got so jealous...And frustrated. I started wondering why I'm so bad and they're so good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If keeping a steady tone would be enough, I may be able to teach you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If any part of you still wishes to produce beautiful music, then I implore you to not give up here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because you will be able to... Someday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (To me, the performance Dad put on for us that day falls into that category.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Figuring out how to produce sounds the way he wanted wasn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm so glad that he didn't give up on playing the trumpet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And he seemed so relieved by the time we said goodbye to each other.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Like he'd found something he'd lost, and been searching ages for...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel a good melody coming together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This might be a bit too cheerful to be used for an N25 song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it still sort of fits us as a group. It might even help me with our next song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, this sounds too pop...
I should probably lower the tempo a little, and the overall tone...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It doesn't need to sound hip or trendy. I want it to feel pure, a bit juvenile and capture a hint of uncertainty. Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, what should we do for dinner?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's coming along pretty well, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This song's a bit more invigorating than our usual ones.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it's enough for a rough demo, so I think I'll stop here for now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? You made dinner all by yourself, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You were so focused on what you were doing that you didn't hear anything I said earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry for not noticing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you working on our next song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No. Remember the boy we met today?
I was composing a song based on him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Would you like to hear it?
Here, use my headphones.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A good melody sort of started coming together in my head, so I worked on it a little. Unfortunately, we probably won't be able to use it for an N25 song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's like he was able to find the light he'd been searching for, and he's embracing it tightly so as to not lose it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If that's what you heard, Mafuyu, then I guess that means I was able to turn my mental image into music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Having that mental image is so vital...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I doubt I would've been able to come up with this melody if that boy hadn't smiled the way he did at the end before we left.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for showing this to me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also, you said that dinner's ready...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I heated up some of that braised fish.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, let's go eat.
